descriptor: Security, automation and AI systems for business

voice.summary: AKOR speaks like an engineer who briefs a boardroom: precise, calm and quietly authoritative. It states what a system does and what it protects.
dos: Name the system and the result in one sentence
Use measured numbers instead of claims
Keep tone confident but never alarming
donts: Do not use fear to sell security

taglines: Systems that watch so you do not
boilerplate: AKOR designs and installs intelligent security, automation and AI systems for businesses and smart infrastructure, helping teams protect sites and run more efficiently.

microcopy.success: Request received. An engineer will call you.

logo.note: A shield states the security promise and sits well beside a vivid green accent.
